descriptionByLocale.it:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Integration and DevOps Engineer (80-100%) Within the IT Operations unit, our team (16 people between Luxembourg and Geneva) is dedicated to integrate new business applications into our ecosystem according to the requirements of different stakeholders (Security/Platform/Production/Infrastructure and Dev). Our team makes our core app evolution easier and smoother, without compromising quality. YOUR ROLE
• Manage the release management process to reduce operational risk in prod and test environments:
• Coordinate planned changes between dev and production teams
• Facilitate the Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings
• Efficiently integrate new business applications into the ecosystem from design to implementation in various environments (Dev/Test/UAT and prod)
• Coordinate and execute technical tasks based on the requirements of different stakeholders (Security/Platform/Production/Infrastructure/provider and Dev)
• Identify and mitigate risks, technical issues, and dependencies across the project
• Collaborate with the Provider (Third-party Package) on Lombard Odier technical requirements
• Develop the project's reference document in collaboration with Dev
• Estimate the workload of IT tasks during the project
• Implement continuous improvement using the Problem Management process to reduce downtime for business applications- Internal stakeholders: Development, Service Management (Incident/Problem Management), DBA, Network, Citrix/Virtualization, Tooling, IT Security, IT Risk.
• External stakeholders: Software and Service Vendors, Business Process Outsourcing Clients (Banks who are using our IT Platform and services) YOUR PROFILE
• Master in IT or equivalent
• Good command of development languages and linked application servers: JAVA, JBOSS, C++
• Good command of CI/CD tooling: Openshift, Kubernetes, DevOps principles

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti.

Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie.

“Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti.

Ingegnere di stoccaggio (80-100%)

Stiamo cercando un Storage & Backup Engineer con una forte passione per l'infrastruttura aziendale, la protezione dei dati e l'automazione. Ti unirai a un team dinamico di 15 esperti di ingegneria del sistema che gestiscono un'infrastruttura globale di oltre 7.000 server, piattaforme di storage enterprise multiple e servizi di backup mission-critical che supportano le operazioni della Banca in tutto il mondo. Questo è un ambiente tecnico su larga scala in cui affidabilità, prestazioni, resilienza e innovazione sono al centro della nostra missione.

Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella progettazione, il funzionamento e l'evoluzione del nostro ecosistema di archiviazione e backup, tra cui tessuti SAN, array di storage enterprise, tecnologie di replica e piattaforme di protezione dei dati. Garantirai la disponibilità, le prestazioni e la scalabilità delle infrastrutture critiche che supportano applicazioni e servizi aziendali.

Le tue responsabilità includono la gestione e l'ottimizzazione di array di storage, switch SAN e configurazioni di zoning, soluzioni di replica Active-Active, piattaforme di backup e ripristino, nonché il monitoraggio delle prestazioni e la pianificazione della capacità attraverso il paesaggio di storage.

LA TUA MISSIONE

• Progettazione, gestione ed evoluzione delle infrastrutture di storage, SAN e Backup aziendali

• Assicurare le prestazioni, la disponibilità e la resilienza dei servizi di archiviazione e protezione dei dati critici

• Contribuire a progetti di modernizzazione delle infrastrutture, tra cui la replica, il ripristino dei disastri e le tecnologie di storage degli oggetti

• Guidare le iniziative di automazione per migliorare l'efficienza operativa e ridurre l'intervento manuale

• Proporre soluzioni innovative per ottimizzare i servizi, migliorare l'affidabilità e ridurre Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)

• Mantenere la documentazione accurata e garantire il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e governance

Il tuo progetto

• Istruzione superiore in informatica o sistemi di comunicazione

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza nel settore

• Forte conoscenza delle tecnologie enterprise Storage e Backup

• Esperienza comprovata gestione array di storage e infrastrutture SAN

• Forte comprensione dell'analisi delle prestazioni di storage, della risoluzione dei problemi e della pianificazione della capacità

• Esperienza con tecnologie di replica Active-Active e soluzioni di disaster recovery

• Buona conoscenza di SAN commutazione, protocolli Fibre Channel e concetti di zoning

• Buona conoscenza delle tecnologie di storage degli oggetti compatibili con S3

• Esperienza con automazione utilizzando Ansible, Python, PowerShell o tecnologie simili

• Esperienza con uno o più dei seguenti prodotti: Hitachi, NetApp, Pure Storage, Brocade, Commvault

• La conoscenza delle tecnologie di virtualizzazione, in particolare VMware, è considerata una risorsa

• La familiarità con le tecnologie dell'infrastruttura Microsoft (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, System Center) è un plus

• La comprensione delle tecnologie di autenticazione e sicurezza come Kerberos, PKI o ADFS è vantaggiosa

• Set mentale strutturato, analitico, proattivo e orientato alla soluzione

• Fluente in entrambi F
descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Storage Engineer (80-100%)

We are looking for a Storage & Backup Engineer with a strong passion for enterprise infrastructure, data protection, and automation. You will join a dynamic team of 15 system engineering experts who manage a global infrastructure of more than 7,000 servers, multiple enterprise storage platforms, and mission-critical backup services supporting the Bank's operations worldwide. This is a large-scale technical environment where reliability, performance, resilience, and innovation are at the core of our mission.

You will play a key role in the design, operation, and evolution of our storage and backup ecosystem, including SAN fabrics, enterprise storage arrays, replication technologies, and data protection platforms. You will ensure the availability, performance, and scalability of critical infrastructure supporting business applications and services.

Your responsibilities will include the management and optimization of storage arrays, SAN switches and zoning configurations, Active-Active replication solutions, backup and recovery platforms, as well as performance monitoring and capacity planning across the storage landscape.

YOUR MISSION

• Design, manage, and evolve enterprise Storage, SAN, and Backup infrastructures

• Ensure the performance, availability, and resiliency of critical data storage and protection services

• Contribute to infrastructure modernization projects, including replication, disaster recovery, and object storage technologies

• Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention

• Propose innovative solutions to optimize services, enhance reliability, and reduce Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)

• Maintain accurate documentation and ensure compliance with security and governance standards

YOUR PROFILE

• Higher education in computer science or communication systems

• Minimum 2 years of experience in the field

• Strong knowledge of enterprise Storage and Backup technologies

• Proven experience managing storage arrays and SAN infrastructures

• Strong understanding of storage performance analysis, troubleshooting, and capacity planning

• Experience with Active-Active replication technologies and disaster recovery solutions

• Good knowledge of SAN switching, Fibre Channel protocols, and zoning concepts

• Good knowledge of S3-compatible object storage technologies

• Experience with automation using Ansible, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies

• Experience with one or more of the following products: Hitachi, NetApp, Pure Storage, Brocade, Commvault

• Knowledge of virtualization technologies, especially VMware, is considered an asset

• Familiarity with Microsoft infrastructure technologies (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, System Center) is a plus

• Understanding of authentication and security technologies such as Kerberos, PKI, or ADFS is advantageous

• Structured, analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset

• Fluent in both F
descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltiges Investieren zu arbeiten. Als innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden ist unsere unabhängige Kanzlei eine der am besten kapitalisierten Bankengruppen der Welt, die fast CHF 300 Milliarden verwaltet und von über 25 Büros auf 4 Kontinenten aus operiert.

Mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ist Lombard Odier ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskretionärem und beratendem Portfoliomanagement, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Verwahrung bietet. Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienstleistungen und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Managers und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie für andere Finanzinstitute.

„Rethink Everything ist unsere Philosophie – sie steht im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker geworden, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu überdenken, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten.

Storage Engineer (80-100%)

Wir suchen einen Storage & Backup Engineer mit einer starken Leidenschaft für Unternehmensinfrastruktur, Datenschutz und Automatisierung. Sie werden Teil eines dynamischen Teams von 15 System-Engineering-Experten sein, die eine globale Infrastruktur mit mehr als 7.000 Servern, mehreren Enterprise-Storage-Plattformen und unternehmenskritischen Backup-Services verwalten, die die Aktivitäten der Bank weltweit unterstützen. Dies ist ein großes technisches Umfeld, in dem Zuverlässigkeit, Leistung, Widerstandsfähigkeit und Innovation im Mittelpunkt unserer Mission stehen.

Sie werden eine Schlüsselrolle bei Design, Betrieb und Entwicklung unseres Speicher- und Backup-Ökosystems spielen, einschließlich SAN-Fabrics, Enterprise-Storage-Arrays, Replikationstechnologien und Datenschutzplattformen. Sie stellen die Verfügbarkeit, Leistung und Skalierbarkeit kritischer Infrastrukturen sicher, die Geschäftsanwendungen und -dienste unterstützen.

Ihre Aufgaben umfassen die Verwaltung und Optimierung von Speicherarrays, SAN-Switches und Zoning-Konfigurationen, Active-Active Replikationslösungen, Backup- und Wiederherstellungsplattformen sowie die Leistungsüberwachung und Kapazitätsplanung in der gesamten Speicherlandschaft.

IHRE ÜBERMITTLUNG

• Entwerfen, Verwalten und Entwickeln von Enterprise Storage, SAN und Backup-Infrastrukturen

• Gewährleistung der Leistung, Verfügbarkeit und Belastbarkeit kritischer Datenspeicher- und -schutzdienste

• Beitrag zu Infrastrukturmodernisierungsprojekten, einschließlich Replikations-, Disaster Recovery- und Objektspeichertechnologien

• Automatisierungsinitiativen vorantreiben, um die betriebliche Effizienz zu verbessern und manuelle Eingriffe zu reduzieren

• Vorschlag innovativer Lösungen zur Optimierung von Dienstleistungen, zur Erhöhung der Zuverlässigkeit und zur Reduzierung der Gesamtbetriebskosten (TCO)

• Pflegen Sie eine genaue Dokumentation und gewährleisten Sie die Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Governance-Standards

IHR PROFIL

• Hochschulbildung in Informatik oder Kommunikationssystemen

• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet

• Starkes Wissen über Enterprise Storage und Backup Technologien

• Bewährte Erfahrung im Management von Storage-Arrays und SAN-Infrastrukturen

• Starkes Verständnis der Speicherleistungsanalyse, Fehlerbehebung und Kapazitätsplanung

• Erfahrung mit Active-Active Replikationstechnologien und Disaster Recovery Lösungen

• Gute Kenntnisse über SAN-Switching, Fibre Channel-Protokolle und Zoning-Konzepte

• Gute Kenntnisse der S3-kompatiblen Objektspeichertechnologien

• Erfahrung in der Automatisierung mit Ansible, Python, PowerShell oder ähnlichen Technologien

• Erfahrung mit einem oder mehreren der folgenden Produkte: Hitachi, NetApp, Pure Storage, Brocade, Commvault

• Kenntnisse über Virtualisierungstechnologien, insbesondere VMware, gelten als Asset

• Vertrautheit mit Microsoft-Infrastrukturtechnologien (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, System Center) ist ein Plus

• Verständnis von Authentifizierungs- und Sicherheitstechnologien wie Kerberos, PKI oder ADFS ist vorteilhaft

• Strukturierte, analytische, proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise

• Fließend in beiden F
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents.

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières.

Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients.

Ingénieur de stockage (80-100%)

Nous recherchons un ingénieur de stockage et de sauvegarde avec une forte passion pour l'infrastructure d'entreprise, la protection des données et l'automatisation. Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique de 15 experts en ingénierie de systèmes qui gèrent une infrastructure mondiale de plus de 7 000 serveurs, de multiples plateformes de stockage d'entreprise et des services de sauvegarde essentiels à la mission qui soutiennent les opérations de la Banque dans le monde entier. C'est un environnement technique à grande échelle où la fiabilité, la performance, la résilience et l'innovation sont au cœur de notre mission.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conception, le fonctionnement et l'évolution de notre écosystème de stockage et de sauvegarde, y compris les tissus SAN, les réseaux de stockage d'entreprise, les technologies de réplication et les plateformes de protection des données. Vous assurerez la disponibilité, le rendement et l'évolutivité des infrastructures essentielles qui soutiennent les applications et les services d'affaires.

Vos responsabilités comprendront la gestion et l'optimisation des tableaux de stockage, des commutateurs SAN et des configurations de zonage, des solutions de réplication active, des plateformes de sauvegarde et de récupération, ainsi que la surveillance des performances et la planification des capacités dans l'ensemble du paysage de stockage.

Votre mission

• Conception, gestion et évolution des infrastructures de stockage, de SAN et de sauvegarde

• Assurer la performance, la disponibilité et la résilience des services essentiels de stockage et de protection des données

• Contribuer aux projets de modernisation de l'infrastructure, y compris la reproduction, la reprise après sinistre et les technologies de stockage des objets

• Conduire les initiatives d'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et réduire l'intervention manuelle

• Proposer des solutions innovantes pour optimiser les services, améliorer la fiabilité et réduire le coût total de propriété (TCO)

• Maintenir une documentation exacte et assurer le respect des normes de sécurité et de gouvernance

VOTRE PROFIL

• Enseignement supérieur en informatique ou en systèmes de communication

• Minimum 2 ans d'expérience dans le domaine

• Forte connaissance des technologies de stockage et de sauvegarde des entreprises

• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion des réseaux de stockage et des infrastructures SAN

• Connaissance approfondie de l'analyse des performances de stockage, du dépannage et de la planification des capacités

• Expérience des technologies de réplication active et des solutions de reprise après sinistre

• Bonne connaissance de la commutation SAN, des protocoles Fibre Channel et des concepts de zonage

• Bonne connaissance des technologies de stockage d'objets compatibles S3

• Expérience de l'automatisation à l'aide de technologies Ansible, Python, PowerShell ou similaires

• Expérience avec un ou plusieurs des produits suivants: Hitachi, NetApp, Pure Storage, Brocade, Comvault

• La connaissance des technologies de virtualisation, en particulier VMware, est considérée comme un atout

• Familiarité avec les technologies d'infrastructure Microsoft (Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, System Center) est un plus

Lavorando all’interno del team di Investimento Sostenibile, l’Analista per la Ricerca Sostenibilità svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell’attuazione, nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento continuo del quadro di investimento sostenibile di Lombard Odier. Garantire credibilità e coerenza, questa funzione è fondamentale per l’offerta di investimento sostenibile dell’azienda e comporta interazioni con i team di investimento e altri stakeholder interni attraverso la gestione patrimoniale e le attività bancarie private. Le responsabilità iniziali si concentreranno sull’applicazione del quadro alle valutazioni di sostenibilità, con lo scopo nel tempo di prendere possesso di specifici flussi di lavoro relativi allo sviluppo e all’attuazione del quadro.

Analista di ricerca di sostenibilità (80-100%)

Il tuo ruolo:

• Contribuire al continuo sviluppo di criteri quadro qualitativi attraverso la ricerca settoriale e a catena del valore; sostenere i miglioramenti ai criteri di framework basati sui dati sfruttando i set di dati esterni e gli strumenti interni.

• Monitorare gli sviluppi in materia di regolamentazione, standard, framework e temi di sostenibilità emergenti

• Lavorare con i team di investimento e altri stakeholder interni per spiegare gli output di valutazione, sostenere nuove idee di investimento e rispondere alle richieste di due diligence o clienti legate alla sostenibilità

• Contribuire a migliorare i flussi di lavoro e la documentazione relativa al quadro di investimento sostenibile e ai processi di investimento, anche attraverso l'introduzione dei flussi di lavoro abilitati all'IA

• Generare intuizioni di ricerca e collaborare con il team di stewardship di investimento sul coinvolgimento aziendale

Il tuo profilo:

• Laurea o post-laurea in sostenibilità, scienze ambientali, politica pubblica o un campo correlato; l'esperienza professionale orientata alla sostenibilità può sostituire uno sfondo accademico specifico per la sostenibilità

• Esperienza prioritaria nella ricerca sulla sostenibilità/ESG, consulenza sulla sostenibilità, finanza sostenibile o mercati dei capitali sostenibili

• Esperienza dimostrata analizzando aziende, settori, modelli di business e divulgazione aziendale dalla prospettiva di rischi, opportunità e impatti legati alla sostenibilità

• Forte comprensione dei problemi di sostenibilità ambientale e sociale e delle loro interconnessioni, nonché dei quadri di sostenibilità, delle certificazioni e degli standard

• La curiosità intellettuale e la capacità di pensare concettualmente alle intersezioni dei mercati finanziari, delle prestazioni aziendali e delle questioni ambientali e sociali

• Comfort con ambiguità e giudizio con dati incompleti o imperfetti

• Capacità di interpretare e organizzare informazioni complesse qualitative e quantitative

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e di prendere la proprietà dei progetti

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Working within the Sustainable Investing team, the Sustainability Research Analyst will play an integral role in the implementation, development and ongoing enhancement of Lombard Odier’s proprietary sustainable investment framework. By ensuring credibility and consistency, this function is central to the firm’s sustainable investment offering and entails interactions with investment teams and other internal stakeholders across the firm’s asset management and private banking activities. Initial responsibilities will focus on the application of the framework to sustainability assessments, with scope over time to take ownership of specific workstreams related to the framework’s development and implementation.

Sustainability Research Analyst (80-100%)

Your Role :

• Assess companies and labelled debt instruments against the firm’s proprietary sustainable investment framework using company disclosures, third-party sustainability data, and other external sources; author written assessments for internal and client-facing use

• Contribute to the continued development of qualitative framework criteria through sector and value chain research; support improvements to data-driven framework criteria by leveraging external datasets and internal tools.

• Monitor developments in sustainability regulation, standards, frameworks, and emerging sustainability themes

• Work with investment teams and other internal stakeholders to explain assessment outputs, support new investment ideas and respond to sustainability-related due diligence or client requests

• Contribute to improving workflows and documentation related to the sustainable investment framework and investment processes, including through the introduction of AI-enabled workflows

• Generate research insights and collaborate with the investment stewardship team on company engagement

Your Profile :

• Degree or postgraduate qualification in sustainability, environmental science, public policy or a related field; sustainability-focused professional experience may substitute for a sustainability-specific academic background

• Prior experience in sustainability/ESG research, sustainability consulting, sustainable finance, or sustainable capital markets

• Demonstrated experience analysing companies, sectors, business models and corporate disclosures from the perspective of sustainability-related risks, opportunities and impacts

• Strong understanding of environmental and social sustainability issues and their interconnections, as well as sustainability frameworks, certifications and standards

• Intellectual curiosity and the ability to think conceptually about the intersections of financial markets, corporate performance, and environmental and social issues

• Comfort with ambiguity and making judgments with incomplete or imperfect data

• Ability to interpret and organise complex qualitative and quantitative information

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects

Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents.

Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières.

Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients.

Au sein de l'équipe d'investissement durable, l'analyste de recherche sur la durabilité jouera un rôle essentiel dans la mise en oeuvre, le développement et l'amélioration continue du cadre d'investissement durable de Lombard Odier. En assurant crédibilité et cohérence, cette fonction est au cœur de l'offre d'investissement durable de l'entreprise et comporte des interactions avec des équipes d'investissement et d'autres intervenants internes dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Les responsabilités initiales seront axées sur l'application du cadre aux évaluations de la durabilité, avec une marge de manœuvre au fil du temps pour prendre en charge certains secteurs de travail liés à l'élaboration et à la mise en oeuvre du cadre.

Analyste de recherche sur la durabilité (80-100%)

Votre rôle :

• Évaluer les entreprises et les titres de créance en fonction du cadre d'investissement durable propre de l'entreprise en utilisant les informations communiquées par l'entreprise, les données sur la durabilité de tiers et d'autres sources externes; évaluer l'auteur par écrit pour l'utilisation interne et axée sur le client

• Contribuer à l'élaboration continue de critères-cadres qualitatifs par la recherche sectorielle et en chaîne de valeur; appuyer l'amélioration des critères-cadres axés sur les données en tirant parti des ensembles de données externes et des outils internes.

• Suivre l'évolution de la réglementation, des normes, des cadres et des nouveaux thèmes relatifs à la durabilité

• Collaborer avec des équipes d'investissement et d'autres intervenants internes pour expliquer les résultats de l'évaluation, appuyer de nouvelles idées d'investissement et répondre aux demandes de diligence raisonnable ou de clients liées à la durabilité

• Contribuer à l'amélioration des flux de travail et de la documentation liés au cadre d'investissement durable et aux processus d'investissement, notamment en introduisant des flux de travail fondés sur l'IA

• Générer des idées de recherche et collaborer avec l'équipe de gérance des investissements sur l'engagement de l'entreprise

Votre profil :

• Diplôme ou diplôme de troisième cycle en durabilité, sciences de l'environnement, politiques publiques ou domaine connexe; expérience professionnelle axée sur la durabilité peut remplacer une formation universitaire spécifique à la durabilité

• Expérience antérieure en recherche sur le développement durable/ESG, en consultation sur le développement durable, en financement durable ou sur les marchés financiers durables

• Expérience démontrée dans l'analyse des entreprises, des secteurs, des modèles d'entreprise et des informations sur les entreprises sous l'angle des risques, opportunités et impacts liés à la durabilité

• Meilleure compréhension des questions de durabilité environnementale et sociale et de leurs interconnexions, ainsi que des cadres de durabilité, des certifications et des normes

• La curiosité intellectuelle et la capacité de penser conceptuellement aux intersections des marchés financiers, de la performance des entreprises et des questions environnementales et sociales

• Confort avec ambiguïté et jugement avec des données incomplètes ou imparfaites

• Aptitude à interpréter et à organiser des informations qualitatives et quantitatives complexes

• Capacité de travailler en toute indépendance et de prendre en charge les projets

Wir bieten auch Asset-Management-Dienstleistungen und Anlagestrategien durch Lombard Odier Investment Managers und bieten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie für andere Finanzinstitute. „Rethink Everything ist unsere Philosophie – sie steht im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

With over 250 professionals, our Investment Solutions department is responsible for providing sophisticated and highly customized investment proposals to our private clients.

Equities & Derivatives Execution Trader (80-100%)

Mission:

• Equities & Derivatives Trade Execution: Execute, monitor, and optimize the bank’s equity and derivative client flows across global markets, ensuring consistent best execution in line with applicable regulatory requirements and internal governance frameworks. The ideal candidate will have a strong expertise in future and option strategies).

• Late Shift: Take part in cross asset execution coverage until the U.S. market close (each execution trader participating in a limited number of late shifts per month)

• Technology & Automation: Actively Contribute to the enhancement of electronic trading strategies, leveraging trading data and analytics to help design implement, and scale new automation process

• Counterparty Interaction: Maintain strong relationships with brokers and market makers to optimize execution and access liquidity

Your Profile:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field

• Experience: Minimum of 3 years in derivatives and equity trading

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in Bloomberg, TradeWeb and order management systems

• Familiarity with algorithmic and electronic trading solutions is highly advantageous

• Analytical & Execution Skills: Strong market analysis capabilities, sound judgment under pressure, and ability to handle high trade volumes with precision and efficiency

• Communication : Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with senior management, counterparties, and technology teams

• Teamwork: Team-oriented mindset with the ability to collaborate effectively with investment professionals and clients

• Project skills: Proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of initiative and active participation in cross-functional projects

• Languages: Fluent in both English and French

• Service minded, accurate, autonomous

• Must be a resident of Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Group Risk Assurance Controls Manager (80–100%)

We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and strategic Risk Assurance Controls Manager to join the Operational Risk Management department in Switzerland. This role sits within the second line of defense and carries full ownership of the Group’s risk assurance and control testing framework, including the design, execution, and continuous enhancement of assurance plans.
The successful candidate will lead and develop control testing activities across the organization, provide independent oversight over first line risk and control frameworks, and deliver high-impact insights to senior management and governance bodies. The role includes direct line management responsibility and requires a strong ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

YOUR ROLE
Leadership & Ownership

• Own, design, and continuously enhance the Group-wide risk assurance control testing framework and annual assurance plan

• Lead and develop a small team (1 FTE), providing coaching, priority setting, and performance oversight

• Act as a subject matter expert and key point of contact for control assurance topics across the organization

• Drive consistency, quality, and efficiency in control testing methodologies and outputs

Control Testing Strategy & Execution

• Define, implement, and execute a risk-based control testing strategy aligned with regulatory expectations and internal priorities

• Oversee and perform periodic and ad-hoc control testing across business units and processes

• Ensure comprehensive coverage of key risks and controls, with a forward-looking and thematic approach

• Challenge the design and operating effectiveness of controls, identifying systemic weaknesses and emerging risks

• Ensure high-quality documentation of testing procedures, results, and conclusions

Second Line of Defense Oversight

• Provide independent oversight and challenge of first line risk management and control frameworks

• Assess the adequacy of Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and other first line control activities

• Engage with senior stakeholders to provide expert opinions on control effectiveness and risk exposure

• Collaborate with Internal Audit and other assurance functions to ensure alignment and avoid duplication

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

• Deliver clear, concise, and impactful reporting to senior management, risk committees, and governing bodies

• Escalate key issues, trends, and systemic control weaknesses in a timely manner

• Provide actionable recommendations to strengthen the control environment and mitigate risks

• Act as a trusted advisor to business and control functions on control design and assurance matters

Issue Management & Follow-up

• Oversee the tracking and validation of remediation actions for identified control deficiencies

• Ensure timely closure of issues and appropriate root cause analysis

• Monitor recurring themes and drive improvements at a structural level

•

Con una storia che dura da oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione di portafoglio discrezionale e di consulenza, servizi patrimoniali e custodia. Offriamo inoltre servizi di gestione patrimoniale e strategie di investimento tramite Lombard Odier Investment Managers e forniamo tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altri istituti finanziari. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo diventati più forti attraverso oltre 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo che ci circonda per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento ai nostri clienti. Specialista in indagini antiriciclaggio e segnalazione di attività sospette (SAR) (80-100%) L'individuo lavorerà come membro del team AML-Investigations & Sanctions del gruppo, che fa parte della conformità del gruppo. Le responsabilità includeranno indagini antiriciclaggio, analisi delle indagini, archiviazione SAR, gestione dei dati dei casi, reporting, formazione e contributo al miglioramento continuo del controllo nell'ambito della conformità alla criminalità finanziaria. IL VOSTRO RUOLO:
• Intraprendere indagini antiriciclaggio in casi di sospetto riciclaggio di denaro e relativi reati presupposto.
• Eseguire analisi investigative sull'attività transazionale e sugli eventi scatenanti AML.
• Preparare le richieste AML/SAR e dare seguito alle richieste per il comitato di due diligence svizzero (DDC) e il comitato di due diligence di gruppo (GDDC).
• Presentare le segnalazioni di attività sospette (SAR) al MROS svizzero e gestire le richieste di follow-up.
• Assistenza agli ordini giudiziari svizzeri in stretta collaborazione con l'Unità legale.
• Coordinare casi AML e SAR multientità e multigiurisdizionali nei paesi in cui operiamo.
• Condurre indagini ad hoc di due diligence rafforzata (EDD).
• Supporto nella comunicazione con la FINMA, ove richiesto, compresa la preparazione di input per le richieste normative e la vigilanza continua.
• Produrre regolari report AML/SAR sulle informazioni di gestione (MI).
• Fungere da punto di contatto per le indagini antiriciclaggio e la consulenza SAR per tutti i colleghi del Gruppo.
• Contribuire alla formazione AML/SAR, aggiornando i moduli di e-learning AML/SAR, tenendo presentazioni e producendo materiali di formazione.
• Analizzare le indagini antiriciclaggio e i rapporti SAR per proporre miglioramenti del controllo e identificare le tendenze antiriciclaggio emergenti.
• Mantenere la procedura operativa standard (SOP) del team AML/SAR.
• Organizzare e partecipare alla chiamata di feedback mensile del gruppo relativa ai responsabili della segnalazione di riciclaggio di denaro (MLRO).
• Mantenere una conoscenza approfondita delle leggi e dei regolamenti AML/SAR e delle tendenze della criminalità finanziaria in materia di riciclaggio di denaro.
• Lavorare in stretta collaborazione con il team Sanzioni del Gruppo sui casi di antiriciclaggio e sovrapposizione di sanzioni. IL TUO PROFILO:
• 3-6 anni di esperienza in indagini antiriciclaggio in un ambiente bancario e conoscenza della segnalazione di attività sospette o di funzioni di conformità simili.
• Laurea in Giurisprudenza/Economia o studi comparabili o esperienza lavorativa equivalente nel settore finanziario.
• Forti capacità analitiche e informatiche (è auspicabile la conoscenza dell'applicazione GoAML).
• Flessibilità, adattabilità con buon intuito e capacità di problem solving.
• Buone capacità comunicative, di networking e organizzative.
• Capacità di stabilire le priorità e di lavorare sotto pressione durante indagini antiriciclaggio impegnative e frenetiche.
• Giocatore di squadra con buone capacità comunicative con un elevato standard di inglese scritto e parlato.
• Domiciliato in Svizzera (con sede a Ginevra). Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L’eccellenza ci spinge a essere i migliori in ciò che facciamo, mentre l’innovazione alimenta il nostro progresso. Il rispetto è alla base di ogni interazione e l'integrità modella le nostre azioni

• Maintain the AML/SAR team standard operating procedure (SOP).

• Organise and participate in the group monthly Money Laundering Reporting Officers (MLRO) feedback call.

• Maintain expert knowledge of AML/SAR law and regulation and financial crime trends with regard to money laundering.

• Work in close collaboration with the Group Sanctions team on cases with AML and sanctions overlap.

• Flexibility, adaptability with good intuition and problem solving skills.

• Good communication, networking and organisational skills.

• Ability to prioritise and work under pressure during fast-paced and demanding AML investigations.

• Team player with good communication skills with a high standard of written and spoken English

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Faire carrière chez Lombard Odier, c'est travailler pour un gestionnaire de patrimoine et d'actifs de renommée mondiale, fortement axé sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre société indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de 300 milliards de CHF et opérant à partir de plus de 25 bureaux répartis sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une société d'investissement proposant une offre complète de gestion discrétionnaire et consultative de portefeuille, de services patrimoniaux et de conservation. Nous proposons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. « Rethink Everything » est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts à travers plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Spécialiste des enquêtes AML et des rapports d'activités suspectes (SAR) (80-100 %) La personne travaillera en tant que membre de l'équipe AML-Enquêtes et sanctions du groupe, qui fait partie de la conformité du groupe. Les responsabilités comprendront les enquêtes AML, l'analyse des enquêtes, le dépôt des SAR, la gestion des données des dossiers, le reporting, la formation et la contribution à l'amélioration continue du contrôle en matière de conformité en matière de criminalité financière. VOTRE RÔLE :
• Entreprendre des enquêtes AML sur des cas de suspicion de blanchiment d'argent et d'infractions sous-jacentes connexes.
• Effectuer une analyse d'investigation sur l'activité transactionnelle et les événements déclencheurs AML.
• Préparer les soumissions AML/SAR et suivre les soumissions pour le comité de diligence raisonnable suisse (DDC) et le comité de diligence raisonnable du groupe (GDDC).
• Déposer des déclarations de soupçon (DAS) auprès du MROS suisse et gérer les demandes de suivi.
• Servir les ordonnances judiciaires suisses en étroite collaboration avec l'unité Juridique.
• Coordonner les dossiers AML et SAR multi-entités et multi-juridictionnels dans les pays dans lesquels nous opérons.
• Mener des enquêtes ponctuelles de diligence raisonnable renforcée (EDD).
• Assistance dans la communication avec la FINMA, si nécessaire, y compris la préparation des contributions aux demandes réglementaires et à la surveillance continue.
• Produire régulièrement des rapports d'information de gestion (IM) AML/SAR.
• Agir en tant que point de contact pour les enquêtes AML et les conseils SAR pour tous les collègues du groupe.
• Contribuer à la formation AML/SAR, en mettant à jour les modules d'apprentissage en ligne AML/SAR, en faisant des présentations et en produisant du matériel de formation.
• Analyser les enquêtes AML et les rapports SAR pour proposer des améliorations de contrôle et identifier les tendances émergentes en matière de AML.
• Maintenir la procédure opérationnelle standard (SOP) de l'équipe AML/SAR.
• Organiser et participer à l'appel mensuel de feedback du groupe pour les responsables des rapports sur le blanchiment d'argent (MLRO).
• Maintenir une connaissance approfondie de la législation et de la réglementation AML/SAR et des tendances de la criminalité financière en matière de blanchiment d'argent.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Sanctions du Groupe sur les cas de chevauchement de sanctions et de LBC. VOTRE PROFIL :
• 3 à 6 ans d'expérience dans les enquêtes AML dans un environnement bancaire et une connaissance du reporting d'activités suspectes ou d'une fonction de conformité similaire.
• Un diplôme universitaire en droit/économie ou des études comparables ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente dans le secteur de l'industrie financière.
• Solides compétences analytiques et informatiques (connaissance de l'application GoAML souhaitable).
• Flexibilité, adaptabilité avec une bonne intuition et compétences en résolution de problèmes.
• Bonnes compétences en communication, en réseautage et en organisation.
• Capacité à établir des priorités et à travailler sous pression lors d'enquêtes AML rapides et exigeantes.
• Esprit d'équipe avec de bonnes compétences en communication avec un haut niveau d'anglais écrit et parlé
• Domicilié en Suisse (basé à Genève). L’ADN de notre Maison est défini par cinq valeurs fondamentales. L'excellence nous pousse à être les meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons, tandis que l'innovation alimente notre progrès. Le respect sous-tend chaque interaction et l'intégrité façonne nos activités.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Per rafforzare ulteriormente il nostro dipartimento di beni privati, stiamo cercando una base di Ginevra Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%) In questo ruolo, contribuirai alla supervisione operativa, finanziaria e analitica dei nostri portafogli Private Assets. Il tuo!
• Assicurare il follow-up amministrativo dei fondi e dei mandati di investimento dei beni privati
• Raccogliere, verificare e elaborare moduli di abbonamento per nuovi investimenti
• Preparare e rilasciare comunicazioni di capitale e distribuzione
• Sostenere la preparazione di report AUM e NNM
• Partecipare alla produzione di track record e analisi delle prestazioni
• Preparare le valutazioni trimestrali dei fondi di investimento dei beni privati
• Lanci del prodotto di supporto da una prospettiva operativa
• Partecipare alla preparazione e all'emissione di fatture client
• Contribuire ai miglioramenti del sistema IT tramite test di accettazione dell'utente e validazione
• Coordinare con gli Accountants del Fondo per garantire la conservazione accurata e l'integrità dei dati
• Preparare report e dashboard regolari per i gestori privati degli investimenti
• Sostenere la preparazione degli aggiornamenti per la gestione senior e le schede
• Eseguire attività di contabilità e di controllo per i prodotti e i mandati di Private Assets
• Sostenere le richieste di audit interno ed esterno e fornire assistenza attiva al team
• Liaise con i dipartimenti di tutto il Gruppo, LOIM e la Banca Privata (ad esempio, Finanza, Operazioni) Il tuo progetto
• Laurea magistrale, idealmente in economia, finanza o disciplina correlata
• 3-5 anni di esperienza nel controllo dei beni privati
• Forte comando dell'inglese (spoken e scritto) e buona conoscenza del francese
• Eccellente abilità di Excel; solida conoscenza di eFront; l'esposizione ad Alteryx o Tableau è un plus
• Rigoroso, orientato ai dettagli e in grado di gestire le priorità e rispettare le scadenze
• Forte giocatore di squadra con una mentalità collaborativa e eccellenti capacità di comunicazione Il DNA della nostra Maison è definito da cinque valori fondamentali. L'eccellenza ci spinge ad essere i migliori a quello che facciamo, mentre l'innovazione alimenta i nostri progressi. Il rispetto sostiene ogni interazione, e l'integrità plasma le nostre azioni. Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.

Private Assets Investment Controller (80-100%)

In this role, you will contribute to the operational, financial, and analytical oversight of our Private Assets portfolios.

YOUR ROLE

• Ensure the administrative follow-up of Private Assets investment funds and mandates

• Collect, verify, and process subscription forms for new investments

• Prepare and release capital call and distribution notices

• Support the preparation of AUM and NNM reporting

• Participate in the production of track records and performance analytics

• Prepare the quarterly valuations of Private Assets investment funds

• Support product launches from an operational perspectives

• Participate in the preparation and issuance of client invoices

• Contribute to IT system enhancements through user acceptance testing and validation

• Coordinate with Fund Accountants to ensure accurate bookkeeping and data integrity

• Prepare regular reports and dashboards for Private Assets Investment Managers

• Support the preparation of updates for Senior Management and Boards

• Perform accounting and controlling activities for Private Assets products and mandates

• Support internal and external audit requests and provide active assistance to the team

• Liaise with departments across the Group, LOIM, and the Private Bank (e.g., Finance, Operations)

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree, ideally in economics, finance, or a related discipline

• 3–5 years of experience in controlling within Private Assets

• Strong command of English (spoken and written) and good knowledge of French

• Excellent Excel skills; solid knowledge of eFront; exposure to Alteryx or Tableau is a plus

• Rigorous, detail‑oriented, and able to manage priorities and meet deadlines

• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and excellent communication skills

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 225 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. The Group Tax Department contributes to the value creation of the Group by controlling its tax. Joining the Group Tax Department as a Tax Intern in our Geneva headquarters, you will :
• Gain understanding of the daily work and organization of a Corporate Tax Affairs Department at the head office of a leading multinational group
• Obtain valuable professional experience whilst supporting the members of the Group Tax Department YOUR ROLE As an intern within our Group Tax Department, you will have the opportunity to participate in current projects and new initiatives. The role mainly consists in assisting all the team members in dealing with Swiss and International direct and indirect tax subjects. Working closely with the entire tax team you may have the opportunity to perform the following tasks:
• Contribute actively to the internal domestic and international tax watch
• Conduct tax studies and legal researches to address concerns raised by the various stakeholders
• Participate in updating the transfer pricing documentation and tax disclosure/compliance obligations
• Assist in the preparation of tax computations and compliance work
• Support the team on indirect tax projects
• Assist when dealing with tax administrations’ requests
• Ad-hoc project work YOUR PROFILE
• Strong interest for corporate taxation
• Master’s degree obtained (or in progress) in tax law, accounting or finance
• Fluent in French and English is necessary
• Good knowledge of Microsoft office suite (especially Excel and Word)
• Ambitious, enthusiastic, with a team oriented spirit and curious to learn through a first experience within a leading multinational group. You enjoy working closely and interact with colleagues within an international environment
• Available per July or September 2026
• Domicile in Switzerland Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication. As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy. It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

Con una storia di oltre 225 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. "Rethink Everything" è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. Sviluppatore completo IA/ML & Reporting Designer Partecipa al dipartimento Tecnologia e Operazioni di Lombard Odier nel team Content and Communications, responsabile della piattaforma di gestione dei contenuti e della produzione/distribuzione dei documenti cliente e partner. Siamo alla ricerca di uno sviluppatore IA/ML e Reporting Designer Full-Stack per contribuire a sviluppare la nostra nuova piattaforma di tecnologia bancaria, che è disponibile anche ad altre banche private svizzere ed europee. Integrato nei team di prodotto, si porterà competenze all'intersezione di LLM e ingegneria del software applicata alla finanza: una maggiore ricerca documentaria (RAG), l'orchestrazione e l'ottimizzazione dell'inferenza (on-prem/cloud), l'integrazione dei modelli nei viaggi di front-office e l'automazione del reporting in produzione. L'industrializzazione e la personalizzazione dei documenti attraverso la suite Quadient Inspire (templati, componenti, flussi di lavoro e pubblicazione), garantendo qualità, tracciabilità e verificabilità end-to-end. Si evolverà all'interno di un'organizzazione agile, vicino agli utenti finali e la professione, con il contatto di tecnologie moderne e provate. LA TUA MISSIONE

• Comprendere le esigenze degli utenti, i problemi da risolvere e i vincoli tecnici.
• Proporre e realizzare soluzioni tecnologiche adeguate tenendo conto degli aspetti sopra menzionati. Il tuo progetto
• Master in informatica con specializzazione in AI, Machine Learning e analisi dei dati seguiti in una delle università politecniche svizzere.
• Prima esperienza professionale o stage significativi nello sviluppo delle applicazioni, nel reporting o negli strumenti documentari.
• Computer Vision: Mastery of LLM/VLM applicata ai documenti (RAG, estrazione visiva, comprensione del layout della pagina).
• Esperienza nel rilevamento di anomalie documentarie (controlli visivi, consistenza semantica, regole aziendali).
• Controllo dei linguaggi di programmazione Java e Python
• Esperienza di ingegneria LLM: fine tuning, quantizzazione, RAG (LangChain/LangGraph), e orchestrazione (LlamaIndex).
• Conoscenza del quadro di sviluppo delle applicazioni web angolari
• Esperienza di contenitore (Dockers / Kubernetes) e DevOps
• Esperienza pratica di metodologie Agile, Scrum è un plus
• Conoscenza attuale della lingua francese e inglese
• Hai una comunicazione eccellente sia per iscritto che per orale

• Propose and implement appropriate technological solutions taking into account the above-mentioned aspects. YOUR PROFILE
• Master in computer science with specialization in AI, Machine Learning and Data analytics followed at one of the Swiss polytechnic universities.
• First professional experience or significant internship in application development, reporting or documentary tools.
• Computer Vision: Mastery of LLM/VLM applied to documents (RAG, visual extraction, page layout comprehension).
• Experience in the detection of documentary anomalies (visual checks, semantic consistency, business rules).
• Controlling Java and Python programming languages
• LLM engineering experience: fine tuning, quantization, RAG (LangChain/LangGraph), and orchestration (LlamaIndex).
• Knowledge of Angular web application development framework
• Container experience (Dockers / Kubernetes) and DevOps
• Practical experience of methodologies Agile, Scrum is a plus
• Current knowledge of French and English
• You have an excellent communication in both writing and oral
• You have a good mind for analysis and a good capacity for abstraction in order to identify and explain the problem to be solved before thinking about solutions
• You are able to give constructive feedback and ready to receive it
• You have a great autonomy
• Home in Switzerland or willing to settle in Switzerland Our House

descriptionByLocale.it:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Internship – Private Banking – 6 months (External Asset Manager team – Luxembourg) The main goal of the position is to support our EAM clients in Europe acting as one of the first points of contact and maintaining strong trusted relationships with all clients throughout the entire life cycle of their business relationship with Lombard Odier, which includes daily and periodic activity. Activities include account opening, periodic compliance reviews, support for client queries, execution services, payment processing and the administration of the relationship to comply with Lombard Odier policies and procedures. YOUR ROLE:
• Support the EAM desk, the RMs, the Business Developer and the Team Head on their day-to-day
• Payments: Ensure that all payments are made in a timely manner.
• Ensure that Callbacks are executed in line with our internal procedure and duly recorded in a contact report
• Manage to keep a low level of Loss (Quality risk report)
• Respect and comply with Group & LOESA directives, Guideline on relationship with EAM and Compliance and risks framework.
• Follow and complete administrative tasks and initiatives launched by the Bank and/or by the Region (documentation gaps/deficiencies, EAM Annual reviews, etc...)
• Reduce significantly by at least 30% the number of pending Doc Priority 1 and 2 and ensure a very low level of new ones
• Ensure that at least for 80% of the new account opened, client have signed myLO access forms in order to increase the penetration rate and to reduce administrative and payment workload.
• Salesforce (CRM of EAM): Ensure the data quality is up to date
• Ensure that EAM central file is in line with our actual standards and up to date (Agreements, Fee Brochure, W8BenE etc.)
• Credit Cards: Take care of all credit card issues and responsibilities.
• Accounts: Ensure a smooth account closure process
• Oversee the scanning and accurate storage of documents within the database.
• E-mails: Ensure that all e-mails receive a timely response. YOUR PROFILE:
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field
• Strong interest in wealth management, financial markets, and private banking activities
• Good understanding of economic and financial concepts, with the ability to support market order execution and administrative processes
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage administrative tasks efficiently
• Proficient in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and Outlook
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Fluent in English; French is an asset Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Propriétaire du produit – Risque et conformité (Plateforme CRM) Le groupe Lombard Odier exploite sa propre plate-forme de technologie bancaire exclusive utilisée par le groupe et fournie à d'autres banques privées et institutions financières par le biais d'un modèle commercial BPO. Le département de la Technologie et des Opérations (T & O) maintient et développe la plateforme en fournissant des solutions aux divisions commerciales de la Banque. Au sein du département Développement de Lombard Odier, nous cherchons à renforcer nos équipes avec un propriétaire de produit expérimenté dédié au domaine Risques et Conformité dans notre produit de gestion de la relation client (CRM). Nos banquiers, principalement développés à l'interne, sont pleinement intégrés dans notre suite d'applications Gestion de patrimoine et sont un différenciateur clé de notre offre technologique. Compte tenu du rôle central de la gestion du cycle de vie des clients et des contrôles de première ligne dans la banque privée, nous visons à porter nos capacités de risque et de conformité de CRM au niveau suivant. En tant que propriétaire de produit pour le risque et la conformité au sein de la plate-forme CRM, vous ferez partie de l'équipe de développement de logiciel de gestion de patrimoine et rapporter au gestionnaire de produit CRM. L'équipe, travaillant dans un cadre agile, réunit tous les produits de Front-office pour les banquiers, les gestionnaires de relations, les clients et les fonctions clés de contrôle. Dans votre travail quotidien, vous collaborerez avec les propriétaires de produits par les pairs, les gestionnaires de produits, les gestionnaires de projets, les analystes d'affaires, les développeurs et, surtout, les intervenants d'affaires de la clientèle privée, la conformité de groupe et les risques, la fiscalité et les rapports réglementaires. Votre rôle
• Définir la vision du produit et la feuille de route pour le risque et la conformité dans le CRM
• Posséder la conception de bout en bout et l'évolution de la notation des risques AML/KYC au sein du CRM
• Mettre en œuvre et rationaliser les processus d'adéquation et de pertinence réglementaires
• Faire office d'interface principale entre les parties prenantes et l'équipe produit, en assurant une compréhension claire, des boucles de rétroaction en temps opportun et la résolution des nouveaux besoins et enjeux.
• Effectuer une surveillance continue du marché et de la réglementation de l'outillage de conformité et des pratiques d'exploitation (p. ex. KYC/CLM, adéquation, moteurs à risque AML) pour évaluer et anticiper les changements.
• Travailler de manière proactive avec nos fournisseurs de troisième partie pour générer de la valeur, en établissant une relation solide et solide.
• Processus RFI/RFP potentiels de plomb
• Favoriser une dynamique d'équipe de produits positive tout en maximisant le ROI des caractéristiques du produit ainsi que la satisfaction des utilisateurs finaux.
• Maintenir et hiérarchiser l'arriéré en incluant les changements et les demandes de projets tout en assurant la maintenance des produits pour garantir la stabilité et la durabilité à long terme.
• Définir et communiquer les priorités de travail, les mises à jour et les questions qui se posent au cours du processus de développement.
• Créer des objectifs de sprint, des épopées actionnables et des histoires d'utilisateurs en fonction des exigences définies pour chaque fonction (fonction) en collaboration avec l'équipe produit.
• Participer à l'estimation des coûts du projet en fonction des besoins opérationnels.
• Veiller à ce que la qualité du produit soit élevée en supervisant la définition, l'exécution et la stratégie d'essai

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. Business Support Intern Integrated to the Management Committee of Lombard Odier T&O Service (Europe) SA, as a Business Support Intern, you will gain hands-on experience in corporate governance and administrative support for executive leadership. This internship will provide exposure to legal frameworks, risk management, and decision-making processes within a corporate environment. Working closely with experienced professionals, you will develop essential skills in organization, communication, and confidentiality. YOUR ROLE - Coordination and preparation of presentation materials for the Management Committee (Townhall, ExCo, etc) - Drafting & circulation of meeting minutes - Preparation of Reporting such as Reg Reporting - Management of common mailbox, - Coordination of internal (sport committee, etc) & external events - Procedures/Policies Management :
• Coordination with their respective managers regarding deadlines for updating procedures
• Coordination of the formal validation process
• · Management of publications on the Intranet and communication with LOT&OS Employees YOUR PROFILE As the sole person in this role, you will benefit from significant autonomy and the following qualities will be expected : - Strong organizational and anticipation skills, - Adaptibility, - Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills, - High level of confidentiality, - Strong writing skills in French and English - Very good command of Words and Office package. NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3). As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy. It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gestionnaire mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs en croissance, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons donc des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous avons connu plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Gestionnaire de comptes et de relations - Clients des fonds de la Custodie mondiale et des fonds de la marque privée (80-100%) Dans le cadre d'une petite équipe dynamique et orientée vers le client, vous êtes responsable du soutien complet de clients institutionnels d'importance stratégique en Suisse allemande. Description du poste :
• Un soutien global aux clients des fonds de dépôt et des fonds de dépôt privés (y compris les opérations de tir) dans les domaines suivants : services bancaires de dépôt, comptabilité des fonds, activités des agents de transfert, services d'infrastructure bancaire, externalisation des processus d'affaires, etc.
• Interface entre les clients et diverses agences internes à Zurich, Genève et Luxembourg (Fondsleitung, Fondsbuchhaltung, Wertschriften-Operations, IT, Legal, Tax etc.) et des tiers (conseillers, superviseurs, consultants, etc.)
• Gestion indépendante des projets clients polyvalents et des travaux d'analystes d'entreprise (par exemple, lancement de fonds d'investissement, offre de nouveaux produits, revues de services, mise en œuvre technique des exigences réglementaires, analyse des besoins des clients, etc.).

• Création de factures de clients et de frais et exécution de contrôles de frais
• Ouverture et maintenance des relations client-compte (production de documents corrects, mise à jour des documents de compte et des contrats conformément aux directives internes, etc.)

• Banque avec professionnalisme et formation continue complète (banque économique HF, CFA /AZEK) ou diplôme universitaire
• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le secteur financier, idéalement dans le soutien des clients institutionnels
• Une vaste expertise dans le service des actifs (par exemple dans le domaine des valeurs mobilières, de la bourse, de l'administration centrale, de la consultation en investissement). Expérience en contact avec des gestionnaires d'actifs externes et/ou des clients d'avantage Global Custody / fonds.

• Très bonne connaissance des utilisateurs de MS Office
• sensibilisation du client et des besoins, haute qualité, travail précis et indépendant
• Personnalité d'équipe, dédiée et communicative avec haute soz

• Wohnsitz in der Schweiz oder Verlagerungsbereitschaft. Die DNA unseres Hauses wird durch fünf Kernwerte definiert.
