Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 225 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Agent principal d'assurance de la conformité (80-100%) Group Compliance Assurance est une équipe dédiée au département Conformité de Lombard Odier. L'équipe basée en Suisse est responsable de la mise en œuvre du plan d'assurance de la conformité du Groupe pour nos entités suisses et étrangères. La portée des activités de l'équipe est conforme au mandat du Département de la conformité, se concentre principalement sur les risques liés à la criminalité financière et aux sanctions et contribue de façon significative à notre cadre de surveillance consolidée de la conformité. Les activités de l'équipe intègrent une approche tournée vers l'avenir, en vue de traduire les résultats des activités d'assurance axées sur les risques en améliorations mesurables de l'environnement de contrôle de la conformité. Votre rôle Basé à Genève et relevant du Chef de Groupe Assurance de Conformité, vous évaluerez (i) la conception et l'efficacité opérationnelle des contrôles pertinents; (ii) le respect des lois et règlements applicables et le respect de nos normes de Conformité et politiques internes pour le Groupe Lombard Odier comme suit:
• Élaborer des plans d'essai et d'examen, y compris tenir un inventaire des scripts d'essai.
• Effectuer et/ou superviser des essais et/ou des examens
• Évaluer et examiner les résultats et communiquer les conclusions préliminaires aux parties prenantes
• Documenter les résultats et leur disposition en tant que questions et actions en consultation avec les propriétaires de questions.
• Finaliser et distribuer les rapports aux parties prenantes.
• Surveiller l'achèvement des problèmes et des actions en mettant fin aux rapports de gestion.
• Préparer et faire rapport sur l'état d'avancement des travaux au besoin;
• Coordonner les activités d'assurance de la conformité avec les autres unités de défense de deuxième ligne et l'audit interne du groupe
• Fournir des conseils et des conseils au front office sur les mesures à prendre pour améliorer la conformité aux résultats des essais et des examens;
• Proposer et contribuer à des projets visant à améliorer continuellement l'environnement de contrôle des risques liés à la conformité et à d'autres initiatives interfonctionnelles pertinentes;
• Conformément aux normes professionnelles de Lombard Odier, vous devrez respecter toutes les exigences légales, réglementaires et internes applicables en matière de conformité, y compris le code de conduite et les politiques et procédures de conformité du groupe. Vous devrez également conserver toutes les certifications professionnelles, selon le cas, pour être pleinement qualifié pour remplir votre rôle, y compris remplir toute la formation obligatoire requise pour obtenir et maintenir ces certifications. VOTRE PROFIL Diplômes/études requis
• Diplôme en droit, économie, finance ou domaine connexe
• Certification professionnelle supplémentaire en conformité un avantage Expérience/connaissance requise
• Une bonne compréhension des environnements réglementaires, notamment du cadre suisse et de l'organisation d'une surveillance consolidée
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience pertinente dans les services financiers dans le secteur public ou privé, avec une exposition particulière à la banque privée
• Expérience en matière de conformité ou d'audit

descriptionByLocale.it:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Head of IT Security Operations & Controls (80-100%) The CISO organization protects Lombard Odier and our Clients against the risk of data theft and business disruption due to cyber-attacks or malicious insiders. The team is composed of approx. 15 talented team members that cover all aspects of security for the Group. Reporting to our Chief Information Security Officer, you will lead the bank’s Operational Security function - owning our SoC (analysts and engineering), incident response, and the effectiveness of our frontline security controls. Your mission is to maximize the safe use of our digital assets, protect customers information, and keep the business fast, compliant, and resilient. YOUR ROLE
• Manage a team of approx. 4 individuals: hiring, coaching, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers.
• SoC leadership & incident response: Run day‑to‑day SoC operations, elevate detection & response maturity, and lead major incident command calmly under pressure. Ensure investigations are rigorous, evidence‑based, and drive tactical fixes as well as strategic improvements.
• Strategy & modernization: Define and execute the SoC strategy for the next 2–3 years, including pragmatic adoption of cloud and AI‑assisted threat detection, triage, and automation (SOAR).
• Security control operations: Own the operating effectiveness of key controls (e.g., vulnerability management, baseline security, DLP). Ensure continuous control monitoring, coverage metrics, and clear KRIs/KPIs that matter to the business.
• Establish, own, and execute the bank’s penetration testing, red team, and purple team roadmap -coordinating internal capabilities and external partners to simulate realistic adversary behaviors and ensure continuous improvement of detection, response, and control effectiveness.
• Oversee the operational workflow of the security team, including triaging incoming support tickets, security requests, and operational tasks. Ensure efficient dispatching and prioritization of work across the CISO organization and maintain clear service‑level expectations with internal stakeholders.
• Enterprise & engineering integration: Partner closely with Architecture, Engineering, Infrastructure, IT Ops, and Developers to land controls and patterns that scale.
• Resilience & recovery: Strengthen incident readiness, tabletop exercises, and post‑incident “close‑call” learning to boost resilience and reduce repeat issues.
• Stakeholder trust: Engage customers, auditors, and internal leaders; translate risk into clear business context; advocate for secure‑by‑default choices. YOUR PROFILE
• 10+ years in cybersecurity with direct leadership of SoC and Incident Response functions, including people leadership (hiring, coaching, performance).
• Demonstrated success running security operations in complex environments (on‑premise and cloud)
• Strong systems thinking; you connect detections, controls, processes, and behaviors into a coherent

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Part of the Lombard Odier Group, Lombard Odier Corporate Advisory supports business owners in their strategic M&A decisions, succession planning and family governance. M&A Intern - 6 months - start date 1st of August or 1st of September Your Role :
• Support the Corporate Advisory team on M&A and corporate finance mandates across sell-side, buy-side and valuation engagements
• Participate in a broad range of tasks including company and market research, preparation of proposals/pitches and transaction documents (teasers, information memoranda, financial analyses, etc.)
• Assist in the preparation of financial models and valuation materials under the supervision of Analyst and Associate
• Contribute to the commercial effort of the team through industry research and preparation of meeting materials
• Ensure rigorous follow-up of internal workstreams and deliverables with proactivity and strong attention to detail
• Liaise with internal partners and departments to support the delivery of timely and accurate information for clients and prospects Your Profile :
• University student enrolled in a relevant Master’s or Bachelor’s degree program
• Person willing to work in an agile and collaborative environment
• Strong numerical and analytical capabilities, including understanding of financial statements analysis, valuation and modelling concepts
• Excellent writing, communication and presentation skills
• Very good team spirit, reliability and sense of client service
• Diligent, autonomous and able to multitask effectively
• Very good IT skills, particularly in Excel and PowerPoint
• Strong sense of confidentiality
• Very good level of English and French. German and/or Swiss German is an asset
• First experience in investment banking, corporate finance, transaction advisory, private equity, management consulting or similar environment is an asset
• Residence in Switzerland Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication. As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy. It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.
